note: site logo link -- renders the fixed Amazon home control
search scope selector -- renders the fixed set of Amazon search categories
search scope label -- renders the fixed label for the search-category selector
search submission control -- renders the fixed search action and its fixed interface label
search submit control -- renders the fixed search action
orders navigation control -- renders the fixed orders link
main navigation toggle -- renders the fixed menu control
primary shopping navigation -- renders fixed Amazon navigation links
results sort selector -- renders the fixed set of sorting controls
search-module section headings -- renders fixed platform labels for result and featured-product modules
add-to-cart widget -- renders the fixed add-to-cart control
product rating popover control -- renders the fixed control for opening rating details
sponsored-content disclosure control -- renders the fixed platform control identifying sponsored placement
results pagination -- renders fixed previous, numbered-page, next, disabled, and ellipsis controls
Amazon footer -- renders fixed footer navigation, legal copy, service descriptions, and back-to-top controls; locale and currency selector subtree is excluded
